                prev_job = c[i-1][k] if i > 0 else 0
                prev_machine = c[i][k-1] if k > 0 else 0
                c[i][k] = max(prev_job, prev_machine) + times[job][k]
        return c

    # NEH heuristic
    # Step 1: Sort jobs by decreasing total processing time
    total_times = [sum(times[j]) for j in range(n)]
    sorted_jobs = sorted(range(n), key=lambda j: -total_times[j])

    # Step 2: Greedy insertion
    schedule = [sorted_jobs[0]]
    for idx in range(1, n):
        job = sorted_jobs[idx]
        best_makespan = float('inf')
        best_pos = 0
        for pos in range(len(schedule) + 1):
            ms = insert_makespan(schedule, job, pos)
            if ms < best_makespan:
                best_makespan = ms
                best_pos = pos
        schedule.insert(best_pos, job)

    # Local search: iterated improvement with swap and insert moves
    def local_search(perm):
        perm = perm[:]
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            current_ms = compute_makespan_fast(perm)
            # Try all swap pairs
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(i+1, n):
                    perm[i], perm[j] = perm[j], perm[i]
                    ms = compute_makespan_fast(perm)
                    if ms < current_ms:
                        current_ms = ms
                        improved = True
                    else:
                        perm[i], perm[j] = perm[j], perm[i]
            # Try all insertion moves
            for i in range(n):
                job = perm[i]
                rest = perm[:i] + perm[i+1:]
                for pos in range(len(rest) + 1):
                    new_perm = rest[:pos] + [job] + rest[pos:]
                    ms = compute_makespan_fast(new_perm)
                    if ms < current_ms:
                        current_ms = ms
                        perm = new_perm
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return perm

    # Apply local search to NEH solution
    best_perm = local_search(schedule)
    best_ms = compute_makespan_fast(best_perm)

    # Try multiple NEH variants with different tie-breaking
    # Variant 2: Sort by front-heavy jobs (sum of first half machines)
    half = m // 2
    front_times = [sum(times[j][:half+1]) for j in range(n)]
    back_times = [sum(times[j][half:]) for j in range(n)]
    
    # Variant: sort by total time + front skew
    sorted_jobs2 = sorted(range(n), key=lambda j: -(total_times[j] + front_times[j]))
    schedule2 = [sorted_jobs2[0]]
    for idx in range(1, n):
        job = sorted_jobs2[idx]
        best_makespan = float('inf')
        best_pos = 0
        for pos in range(len(schedule2) + 1):
            ms = insert_makespan(schedule2, job, pos)
            if ms < best_makespan:
                best_makespan = ms
                best_pos = pos
        schedule2.insert(best_pos, job)
    
    perm2 = local_search(schedule2)
    ms2 = compute_makespan_fast(perm2)
    if ms2 < best_ms:
        best_ms = ms2
        best_perm = perm2

    # Variant 3: sort by back-heavy jobs
    sorted_jobs3 = sorted(range(n), key=lambda j: -(total_times[j] + back_times[j]))
    schedule3 = [sorted_jobs3[0]]
    for idx in range(1, n):
        job = sorted_jobs3[idx]
        best_makespan = float('inf')
        best_pos = 0
        for pos in range(len(schedule3) + 1):
            ms = insert_makespan(schedule3, job, pos)
            if ms < best_makespan:
                best_makespan = ms
                best_pos = pos
        schedule3.insert(best_pos, job)
    
    perm3 = local_search(schedule3)
    ms3 = compute_makespan_fast(perm3)
    if ms3 < best_ms:
        best_ms = ms3
        best_perm = perm3

    return best_perm
